title: private_logistics_probe structured log schema
description: Versioned structured log schema for the exploratory diagnostic probe. Emitted as parseable key=value [PROBE <kind>] lines through the tesmioloader log. Raw observations are kept separate from interpreted events; dropped observations invalidate derived results. SNAPSHOT records are labelled exploratory telemetry: NOT accumulated fuel burn, NOT trip-boundary verification, NOT trip-cost validation.
line_format: [PROBE <KIND>] seq=<u32> ts=<f64> thr=<u64> kind=<name> schema=<u32> committed=<0|1> load=<0|1> unload=<0|1> complete=<0|1> gap=<0|1> error=<0|1> synth=<0|1> <kind-specific fields...>

time.simulation_tick: sim day/month/year and time_of_day from sim_clock getDay()/getTimeOfDay(); -1/0.0 when sim_clock unavailable

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: unique session id (start tick xor process id)

record_kinds.purpose: raw observation of a transfer/movement call (event/call sequence, raw values)

fields.name: site
fields.description: observation site, e.g. transfer:0x420350 or synthetic:load

fields.name: ded
fields.description: actual fuel deduction fb - fa (tonnes), -1 = gap

fields.name: conf
fields.description: evidence confidence: verified | partial | unverified | synthetic | unsupported

record_kinds.purpose: interpreted event kept separate from raw records: trip boundary / gap / error

fields.name: what
fields.description: interpretation label, e.g. trip_open_load | trip_complete | replay_attempted | unsupported_unload | confirm_cannot_repair

record_kinds.purpose: trip summary with settlement-time fuel price and currency

fields.name: replayed
fields.description: replay attempts (always 0: closed trips cannot replay)

fields.name: unsupported
fields.description: unsupported trips (cannot be repaired by confirmation)

fields.name: dup_loads
fields.description: additional loads that were not duplicates

fields.name: fuel_price
fields.description: settlement-time fuel price or unavailable (Phase 1: no price source read)

fields.name: currency
fields.description: settlement currency or unavailable (Phase 1: no currency API consumed)

fields.name: note
fields.description: phase1_no_price_source while no live hook/pricing exists

record_kinds.purpose: dropped observation; invalidates affected derived results
explicitly labelled synthetic input (selftest exercise only)
sampled vehicle snapshot (exploratory telemetry only; NOT fuel burn, NOT trip verification, NOT cost)

fields.name: day
fields.description: sim day at snapshot (from sim_clock getDay, -1 when no world)

fields.name: mon
fields.description: sim month (from sim_clock getMonth, -1 when no world)

fields.name: yr
fields.description: sim year (from sim_clock getYear, -1 when no world)

fields.name: tod
fields.description: time of day fraction (from sim_clock getTimeOfDay)

fields.name: veh
fields.description: selected vehicle identity (null when no match / lost)

fields.name: do
fields.description: selected DO building identity (null when no match / lost)

fields.name: fuel_slot_valid
fields.description: fuel slot found and readable (independent of mirror)

fields.name: fuel_tons
fields.description: fuel slot tonnes (from cargo slot matching game+0xC3F0); -1 if unavailable

fields.name: mirror_valid
fields.description: fuel mirror at veh+0x5F0 readable (does NOT validate fuel slot)

fields.name: cargo_valid
fields.description: cargo vector readable; missing/unreadable is unavailable, not zero

fields.name: cargo
fields.description: bounded cargo listing "res=tons ..."; empty if unavailable

fields.name: kind
fields.description: vehicle kind raw value (0x42 = road truck); -1 if unavailable

fields.name: state
fields.description: vehicle state raw value; -1 if unavailable; does not invalidate selection

fields.name: mode
fields.description: vehicle mode raw value (9 = loaded travel); -1 if unavailable; does not invalidate selection

fields.name: home_matches
fields.description: vehicle home depot == selected DO; -1 if unavailable

constraints: No treasury or payment API is ever consumed; no money is issued.
Raw records (EVENT) and interpreted records (INTERP) are separate record kinds.
No blocking disk IO from hooked game execution; log lines go through the loader's Logf.
All synthetic input carries synth=1 and is never treated as a game observation.
Default loading (enabled=0) patches no code and dereferences no unverified game object.
SNAPSHOT records are exploratory telemetry: not accumulated fuel burn, not trip-boundary verification, not trip-cost validation.
Selection requires building type 43 (road DO) and exactly one eligible vehicle whose home depot matches that DO; zero or multiple candidates fail closed (no selection).

Identity/lifetime (pointer validity + home depot match) is separate from activity state (kind/state/mode); a selected vehicle is retained across loading/travel/unloading, and state/mode changes do not invalidate it.
Every measurement field carries a *_valid flag; missing/unreadable values are -1 (unavailable), never zero or inferred. A readable mirror does NOT validate the authoritative fuel slot.
Calendar day/month/year come directly from sim_clock accessors (getDay/getMonth/getYear); they are never derived from one another.
The sim_clock SUB_TICK subscriber is the only observation mechanism; no inline hook, no code patch, no mid-function instrumentation.
The snapshot queue owns its text and drops new samples when full or contended; worker emits DROP counters.
Enabled plugin, logger and clock modules are pinned for process lifetime; DllMain performs no cleanup or waits. Restart to remove.
First experiment: one launch and one save; no reload, reassignment or demolition. World invalidation is not verified.
coexistence: The probe registers a sim_clock subscriber; it does not patch code, so it cannot conflict with private_logistics' call-site patches.
Two plugins consuming sim_clock simultaneously are not assumed safe; subscriber integration requires review.
observation_seq: Snapshot capture sequence, distinct from serialized log seq; loss is also reported with DROP. No engine movement identity is implied.
